statement: For a tree augmented with a leaf cycle, tracking L[u] (leftmost leaf) and R[u] (rightmost leaf) per subtree enables a tree decomposition with bag size <= 4 and K <= 3N bags. The spine-link-head bag pattern (S/Lnk/H) covers all tree and ring edges while maintaining the running intersection property.
regime: Trees with preorder-numbered vertices where leaves form a contiguous cycle; N up to 100000
mechanism: Preorder numbering guarantees leaves in each subtree are contiguous. S bags carry R[u] across the child chain for parent connectivity. H bags cover tree edges and serve as connection points to child subtrees. Lnk bags cover inter-subtree ring edges. The wraparound ring edge is covered by S_1 at the root.
applicability_bounds: Applies to trees with the specific numbering property (preorder + counterclockwise ordering). Generalizes to any tree where leaves in subtrees are contiguous in the ring order.
